server.name: io.github.kryptobaseddev/cleo-mcp-server
server.description: Task management protocol for solo developers and AI coding agents with 2-gateway CQRS pattern
server.title: CLEO MCP Server

environmentVariables.description: Path to CLEO project directory (must contain .cleo/ folder)
environmentVariables.name: CLEO_PROJECT_DIR

features: CQRS 2-gateway pattern (94% token reduction vs traditional MCP tool approach)
RCSD-IVTR lifecycle protocol enforcement
4-layer validation (schema, semantic, referential, protocol)
96 operations across 8 domains
Anti-hallucination validation on all task operations
Atomic file operations with backup and rollback

tools.description: Read-only operations across 8 domains: tasks, session, orchestrate, research, lifecycle, validate, release, system
tools.name: cleo_query

tools.description: Write operations across 8 domains: tasks, session, orchestrate, research, lifecycle, validate, release, system
tools.name: cleo_mutate
